title: Wavemother's Sickle
summary: +2 sickle adds Cold damage and gives Advantage against Wet targets.

fields.Weapon: Simple, one-handed, Light, 5-ft melee. +2 attacks. 1d4 + 2 Slashing plus Strength and 1d4 Cold.
fields.Watery Guidance: Advantage against Wet targets. The source reports it affects all the wearer’s attack rolls, including attacks made with other weapons.
fields.Lacerate: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Melee attack for weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Bleeding for 2 turns. Bleeding deals 2 Slashing at turn start, gives disadvantage on Constitution saves and ends on healing. The condition source lists Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes and most Undead as immune, with Ghasts and Ghouls as exceptions.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
